records.title: Mitigating Catastrophic Forgetting in Target Language Adaptation of LLMs via Source-Shielded Updates
records.reason: Read the primary method and experiments. Source-Shielded Updates modifies model parameters for target-language adaptation to reduce catastrophic forgetting, a training/fine-tuning method rather than inference-time efficiency.

records.title: Cognitive Mirrors: Exploring the Diverse Functional Roles of Attention Heads in LLM Reasoning
records.reason: The work studies functional roles of attention heads in reasoning; this is an analysis of model behavior, not a concrete inference-time efficiency method.

records.title: How Many Tokens Do 3D Point Cloud Transformer Architectures Really Need?
records.reason: This study estimates token needs for 3D point-cloud transformer architectures; the task and models are point-cloud perception, not LLM inference or serving.

records.title: xbench: Tracking Agents Productivity Scaling with Profession-Aligned Real-World Evaluations
records.reason: xbench evaluates agent productivity with profession-aligned real-world tasks; it is a benchmark rather than an inference efficiency mechanism.
